title: Susan McCasland accepted a calendar invite for a DeLonge-Podesta meeting

tellings.quote: a calendar notification shows that Susan herself accepted a Google calendar invite for something called a Dong Podesta meeting.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a document from the Podesta emails, a batch of private emails belonging to the political adviser John Podesta that the website WikiLeaks made public. According to Michels, a calendar notice from around 2015 or 2016 shows that Susan McCasland, a senior US Air Force officer, herself accepted a Google calendar invite for a "DeLonge Podesta meeting", meaning a meeting between Podesta and the musician Tom DeLonge in Washington, D.C. Michels tells it because, if so, it would place a senior military figure directly inside DeLonge's efforts to reach powerful people about UFOs.
